D.BIZ_YR AS BIZ_YR /*서비스실행사업년도*/ , B.RSFR_INST_NO AS INST_NO /*기관번호*/ , (SELECT INST_NM FROM SAA000 WHERE INST_NO = B.RSFR_INST_NO) AS INST_NM /*기관명*/ , B.RESRCE_NO AS RESRCE_NO /*자원번호*/ , B.PVSN_RESRCE_NM AS RESRCE_NM /*자원명*/ , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'BGT_IMPL_CL_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.BGT_IMPL_CL_SE_CD) AS BGT_IMPL_CL_SE_NM /*예산집행명*/ , A.BGT_IMPL_CL_SE_CD AS BGT_IMPL_CL_SE_CD /*예산집행분류구분코드*/ , DEC_B64((SELECT FLNM_ENCPT FROM SCA100 WHERE ENFSN_NO = A.APLY_PIC_NO)) AS APLCNT_NM /*신청자명*/ , A.APLY_DT AS APLY_DT /*신청일자*/ , A.APRV_DT AS APRV_DT /*승인일자*/ , DEC_B64((SELECT FLNM_ENCPT FROM SCA100 WHERE ENFSN_NO = A.APRV_PIC_NO)) AS APRV_PIC_NM /*승인자명*/ , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'APRV_STTS_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.APRV_STTS_SE_CD) AS APRV_STTS_SE_NM /*승인상태명*/ , A.APRV_STTS_SE_CD AS APRV_STTS_SE_CD /*승인상태구분코드*/ , A.PRGRS_RESULT_CN /*진행결과 내용*/
FROM AFA510 A /*예산실적 테이블*/ LEFT OUTER JOIN SDA100 B /*자원기본 테이블*/ ON A.RESRCE_NO = B.RESRCE_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN SDA420 C /*서비스실행사업 테이블*/ ON B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = C.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN SDA400 D /*서비스사업 테이블*/ ON C.SRVC_BIZ_NO = D.SRVC_BIZ_NO WHERE 1=1 AND D.BIZ_YR = #{BIZ_YR} AND B.RSFR_INST_NO LIKE #{INST_NO} ||'%' AND B.RESRCE_NO LIKE #{RESRCE_NO} || '%' AND A.BGT_IMPL_CL_SE_CD LIKE #{BGT_IMPL_CL_SE_CD} || '%' AND A.APRV_STTS_SE_CD LIKE #{APRV_STTS_SE_CD} || '%'

SELECT A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS BGT_IMPL_LCLAS_SE_CD, A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS BGT_IMPL_SE_NM_L, B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS BGT_IMPL_MLSFC_SE_CD, B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS BGT_IMPL_SE_NM_M, C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS BGT_IMPL_SCLAS_SE_CD, C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS BGT_IMPL_SE_NM_S, '0' AS BGT_IMPL_AMT FROM SAC100 A INNER JOIN SAC100 B ON A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = B.UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE INNER JOIN SAC100 C ON B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = C.UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE WHERE A.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'BGT_IMPL_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND B.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'BGT_IMPL_MLSFC_SE_CD' AND C.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'BGT_IMPL_SCLAS_SE_CD' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 IS NULL AND B.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 IS NULL AND C.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 IS NULL ORDER BY BGT_IMPL_SCLAS_SE_CD

INSERT INTO AFA521( /*예산실적상세 테이블*/ RESRCE_NO /*자원번호*/ , BGT_IMPL_CL_SE_CD /*예산집행분류구분코드*/ , BGT_IMPL_LCLAS_SE_CD /*예산집행대분류구분코드*/ , BGT_IMPL_MLSFC_SE_CD /*예산집행중분류구분코드*/ , BGT_IMPL_SCLAS_SE_CD /*예산집행소분류구분코드*/ , DEL_YN , MDFCN_DT /*수정일시*/ , BGT_IMPL_AMT /*예산집행금액*/ , FRST_RGTR_ID /*최초등록자아이디*/ , LAST_MDFR_ID /*최종수정자아이디*/ ) SELECT #{RESRCE_NO} , #{BGT_IMPL_CL_SE_CD} , BGT_IMPL_LCLAS_SE_CD , BGT_IMPL_MLSFC_SE_CD , BGT_IMPL_SCLAS_SE_CD , #{DEL_YN} , SYSDATE , BGT_IMPL_AMT , FRST_RGTR_ID , LAST_MDFR_ID FROM AFA520 WHERE RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO__origin} AND BGT_IMPL_CL_SE_CD = #{BGT_IMPL_CL_SE_CD__origin}

SELECT * FROM (SELECT D.BIZ_YR /*사업년도*/ , F.INST_NO /*기관번호*/ , F.INST_NM /*기관명*/ , B.RESRCE_NO /*자원번호*/ , B.PVSN_RESRCE_NM AS RESRCE_NM /*자원명*/ , E.BGT_IMPL_CL_SE_CD /*예산실적분류구분코드*/ , E.BGT_IMPL_LCLAS_SE_CD /*예산실적대분류코드*/ , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'BGT_IMPL_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = E.BGT_IMPL_LCLAS_SE_CD AND USE_YN = 'Y' ) AS BGT_IMPL_SE_NM_L /*예산실적대분류명*/ , E.BGT_IMPL_MLSFC_SE_CD /*예산실적중분류코드*/ , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'BGT_IMPL_MLSFC_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = E.BGT_IMPL_MLSFC_SE_CD AND USE_YN = 'Y' ) AS BGT_IMPL_SE_NM_M /*예산실적중분류명*/ , E.BGT_IMPL_SCLAS_SE_CD /*예산실적소분류코드*/ , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'BGT_IMPL_SCLAS_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = E.BGT_IMPL_SCLAS_SE_CD AND USE_YN = 'Y' ) AS BGT_IMPL_SE_NM_S /*예산실적소분류명*/ , E.BGT_IMPL_AMT /*예산실적금액*/
FROM AFA510 A /*예산실적 테이블*/ LEFT OUTER JOIN SDA100 B /*자원기본 테이블*/ ON A.RESRCE_NO = B.RESRCE_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN SDA420 C /*서비스실행사업 테이블*/ ON B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = C.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN SDA400 D /*서비스사업 테이블*/ ON C.SRVC_BIZ_NO = D.SRVC_BIZ_NO AND D.BIZ_YR = #{BIZ_YR} LEFT OUTER JOIN AFA520 E /*예산실적상세 테이블*/ ON A.RESRCE_NO = E.RESRCE_NO AND A.BGT_IMPL_CL_SE_CD = E.BGT_IMPL_CL_SE_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN SAA000 F /*공통코드값 테이블*/ ON F.INST_NO = B.RSFR_INST_NO WHERE 1=1 AND D.BIZ_YR LIKE #{BIZ_YR} AND A.RESRCE_NO LIKE #{RESRCE_NO} || '%' AND B.RSFR_INST_NO LIKE #{INST_NO} || '%' AND A.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' ) PIVOT( MIN(BGT_IMPL_AMT) FOR BGT_IMPL_CL_SE_CD IN('01' AS BGT_IMPL_AMT_1 ,'02' AS BGT_IMPL_AMT_2 ,'03' AS BGT_IMPL_AMT_3 ,'04' AS BGT_IMPL_AMT_4 ,'05' AS BGT_IMPL_AMT_5 ,'06' AS BGT_IMPL_AMT_6 ,'07' AS BGT_IMPL_AMT_7 ,'08' AS BGT_IMPL_AMT_8 ,'09' AS BGT_IMPL_AMT_9 ,'10' AS BGT_IMPL_AMT_10 ,'11' AS BGT_IMPL_AMT_11 ,'12' AS BGT_IMPL_AMT_12 ,'13' AS BGT_IMPL_AMT_A ,'14' AS BGT_IMPL_AMT_B ,'15' AS BGT_IMPL_AMT_C ,'16' AS BGT_IMPL_AMT_D ,'17' AS BGT_IMPL_AMT_E ,'18' AS BGT_IMPL_AMT_F ,'19' AS BGT_IMPL_AMT_G ,'20' AS BGT_IMPL_AMT_H ) ) ORDER BY BGT_IMPL_SCLAS_SE_CD
